title.en: Management as an art, a science and a profession

heading.en: Is a manager like a doctor or like a painter?

hook.en: A doctor needs a licence to practise, a painter does not. A manager uses principles like a scientist and creativity like an artist. So what exactly is management?
hook.kn: ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಪರವಾನಗಿ ಬೇಕು, ಚಿತ್ರಕಾರರಿಗೆ ಬೇಡ. ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಯಂತೆ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು, ಕಲಾವಿದರಂತೆ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು?

objectives.en: Test management against the features of an art
Explain why management is an inexact science
Explain why management is not a full profession

narration.en: A doctor needs a licence to practise, a painter does not. A manager uses principles like a scientist and creativity like an artist. So what exactly is management?
narration.kn: ವೈದ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಪರವಾನಗಿ ಬೇಕು, ಚಿತ್ರಕಾರರಿಗೆ ಬೇಡ. ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಿಯಂತೆ ತತ್ವಗಳನ್ನು, ಕಲಾವಿದರಂತೆ ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಾಗಾದರೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಏನು?

body.en: An art has existing theoretical knowledge, personalised application of that knowledge, and is based on practice and creativity. Managers study management literature but each applies it in an individual style and improves with practice. So management is an art.

narration.en: An art has existing theoretical knowledge, personalised application of that knowledge, and is based on practice and creativity. Managers study management literature but each applies it in an individual style and improves with practice. So management is an art.
narration.kn: ಕಲೆಗೆ ಸೈದ್ಧಾಂತಿಕ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ಅನ್ವಯ, ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆ ಬೇಕು. ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರು ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಶೈಲಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಒಂದು ಕಲೆ.

body.en: A science has a systematised body of knowledge, principles based on experimentation, and universal validity. Management has systematic principles, but because it deals with human behaviour its principles are not exact and cannot be applied identically everywhere. So management is an inexact or soft science.

points.en: Universal validity: only partly, so an inexact science

narration.en: A science has a systematised body of knowledge, principles based on experimentation, and universal validity. Management has systematic principles, but because it deals with human behaviour its principles are not exact and cannot be applied identically everywhere. So management is an inexact or soft science.
narration.kn: ವಿಜ್ಞಾನಕ್ಕೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಿತ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ಪ್ರಯೋಗ ಆಧಾರಿತ ತತ್ವಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವತ್ರಿಕ ಮಾನ್ಯತೆ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಮಾನವ ವರ್ತನೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಅದು ಅನಿಖರ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ.

body.en: A profession has a well-defined body of knowledge, restricted entry through an examination or degree, a professional association, an ethical code of conduct and a service motive. Management has the body of knowledge, but anyone can become a manager without a compulsory degree, and membership of a body such as the All India Management Association is not compulsory. So management is not a full-fledged profession.

narration.en: A profession has a well-defined body of knowledge, restricted entry through an examination or degree, a professional association, an ethical code of conduct and a service motive. Management has the body of knowledge, but anyone can become a manager without a compulsory degree, and membership of a body such as the All India Management Association is not compulsory. So management is not a full-fledged profession.
narration.kn: ವೃತ್ತಿಗೆ ಜ್ಞಾನ, ನಿರ್ಬಂಧಿತ ಪ್ರವೇಶ, ವೃತ್ತಿಪರ ಸಂಘ, ನೈತಿಕ ಸಂಹಿತೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸೇವಾ ಮನೋಭಾವ ಬೇಕು. ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕರಾಗಲು ಕಡ್ಡಾಯ ಪದವಿ ಬೇಕಿಲ್ಲ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲ.

problem.en: Ravi has no MBA but runs a successful textile shop in Davanagere. Ananya, an MBA, manages a hospital using the same principles she learnt but in her own style. What do these two cases tell us about management?

steps.en: Ravi manages without any compulsory degree: entry is not restricted, so management is not a full profession.
Ananya applies the same principles in her own way: personalised application, a feature of art.
She uses principles studied systematically: a feature of science, though inexact because people differ.

answer.en: Management is an art and an inexact science, but not a full-fledged profession

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Ravi has no MBA but runs a successful textile shop in Davanagere. Ananya, an MBA, manages a hospital using the same principles she learnt but in her own style. What do these two cases tell us about management?
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer. Let us see which team scores most.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ. ಯಾವ ತಂಡ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ ನೋಡೋಣ.

points.en: Management is an art: knowledge applied personally with practice and creativity.
points.kn: ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಒಂದು ಕಲೆ: ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯಿಂದ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವುದು.

points.en: Management is an inexact science because it deals with people.
Management is not a full profession: entry is not restricted.
points.kn: ಪ್ರವೇಶ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲದ ಕಾರಣ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲ.

homework.en: Make a table: features of a profession in one column, whether management satisfies each in the other.

narration.en: Recap. Management is an art: knowledge applied personally with practice and creativity. Management is an inexact science because it deals with people. Management is not a full profession: entry is not restricted.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಒಂದು ಕಲೆ: ಜ್ಞಾನವನ್ನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮತ್ತು ಸೃಜನಶೀಲತೆಯಿಂದ ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವುದು. ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಜನರೊಂದಿಗೆ ವ್ಯವಹರಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ಅನಿಖರ ವಿಜ್ಞಾನ. ಪ್ರವೇಶ ನಿರ್ಬಂಧವಿಲ್ಲದ ಕಾರಣ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಪೂರ್ಣ ವೃತ್ತಿಯಲ್ಲ.
